engagement.hypothesis: Aiming at a wounded ally/enemy melee midpoint when urgent actions have passed increases useful hook opportunities and mean kill margin by at least 2.

fountain.hypothesis: Rejecting non-support straight throws through the true fountain disk avoids accidental bounces and improves mean kill margin by at least 2.

gate.screen: all 24 complete; mean bank-paired kill margin >=2; seed-block bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; zero reference or round-trip mismatches; eligible changed decisions >0
gate.confirmation: all 48 fresh games complete; mean margin >=1; seed-block bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; zero mismatches
gate.selection: If both pass choose larger confirmation mean margin. Otherwise keep baseline. Do not combine two untested edits.
gate.hosted: Local retention is an experimental artifact only. League promotion requires separate pinned hosted confirmation as documented in eval-design; no promotion from this local screen.

critique: Head-to-head seed blocks test this mirror matchup only, not causal gain versus a third opponent.
Two banks for a map are correlated: bootstrap seed blocks, not games.
24 games are directional with low power for small benefits: failure to pass means no retention, not proof of no effect.
Centroid can miss or pull an ally out of a favorable fight; require wounded ally and protect prior urgent actions.
Straight ray exclusion may remove useful rebounds; rejected hooks are mechanism exposure, not proof of waste.
Native synchronous actions do not reproduce hosted timing.
curve_hook: Do not rerun the rejected E02 return-sweep with old seeds or adopt unconditional lateral casting. Record evidence-corrected skill proposal as inactive.
